## Problem statement

What operational reasoning problem does this address? Describe the gap in the current pipeline or domain model.

## Proposed solution

What would you add or change? Keep the description focused on one capability.

## Why this belongs in ODIS

Explain why this fits an operational reasoning platform — not just what you want, but why it belongs in the core architecture rather than in application-specific code.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is the proposed approach preferable?

## Architectural impact

Which layers would change (domain, application, infrastructure, examples, tests)? Does this preserve append-only semantics and the separation of evidence, signal, assessment, and decision?

## Additional context

Links to related issues, demos, or prior discussion.
